findings.title: Customer reports no friction / positive ease-of-use with booking tool
findings.description: When asked directly if there was any friction, however tiny, Rosa Ibáñez stated the booking flow (book a session, get a reminder, show up) is easy enough for her non-technical greenhouse staff to use unassisted. This is positive feedback with no defect or missing capability identified.
findings.quote: No, it's easy. My growers aren't tech people, and even they manage it. Book a session, get a reminder, show up.
findings.severity_reason: No defect reported; purely affirmative feedback about existing product behavior.
findings.match_note: Not a catalogue match; explicitly stated as a non-issue, offered as praise rather than a problem to fix.

findings.title: Customer declines to name any desired feature, asks product to stay unchanged
findings.description: Asked if there was anything she wished the product did, Rosa said not really, that she doesn't need 'fancy' features, and explicitly asked the team not to over-engineer or redesign the tool. No specific capability or defect was named.
findings.quote: I don't need fancy. I need it to keep doing exactly what it does. Please don't over-engineer it.
findings.severity_reason: No concrete ask; a general preference for stability rather than a feature request or bug.
findings.match_note: No catalogue match; this is an anti-request (keep as-is), not a specific missing capability.

findings.title: Customer curiosity about coach-matching methodology (answered on call)
findings.description: Rosa asked how the coach-matching process worked for a specific skeptical employee (Miguel), expecting a mismatch given his profile. Tomás explained matching considers background and communication style, and Rosa confirmed the pairing worked well. This was a question that was resolved during the call, not a complaint or defect.
findings.quote: Can I ask — how did the coach match work for him? Because I was braced for a mismatch.
findings.severity_reason: Informational question, satisfactorily answered live on the call; no product gap identified.
findings.match_note: Not in catalogue; a service/methodology question with a positive outcome, not an actionable product issue.
